# netbox_config_context (Resource)

A NetBox config context (extras.configcontext): JSON data merged into the rendered context of the devices and virtual machines its scope selects.

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/extras/configcontext/):

> Context data is made available to devices and/or virtual machines based on their relationships to other objects in NetBox. For example, context data can be associated only with devices assigned to a particular site, or only to virtual machines in a certain cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_config_context_profile" "test" {
  name = "test-config-context-profile"
}

resource "netbox_site" "test" {
  name = "test-site"
}

resource "netbox_device_role" "test" {
  name = "test-device-role"
}

resource "netbox_tag" "test" {
  name = "test-tag"
}

resource "netbox_config_context" "test" {
  name            = "test-config-context"
  weight          = 500
  description     = "test-description"
  is_active       = true
  data            = jsonencode({ ntp_servers = ["192.0.2.1", "192.0.2.2"] })
  profile_id      = netbox_config_context_profile.test.id
  site_ids        = [netbox_site.test.id]
  device_role_ids = [netbox_device_role.test.id]
  tag_slugs       = [netbox_tag.test.slug]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `data` (String) The context data as JSON text (use jsonencode()).
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `cluster_group_ids` (Set of Number) Ids of the cluster groups the context applies to; empty means all.
- `cluster_groups` (Set of Number, Deprecated) Deprecated alias of cluster_group_ids.
- `cluster_ids` (Set of Number) Ids of the clusters the context applies to; empty means all.
- `cluster_type_ids` (Set of Number) Ids of the cluster types the context applies to; empty means all.
- `cluster_types` (Set of Number, Deprecated) Deprecated alias of cluster_type_ids.
- `clusters` (Set of Number, Deprecated) Deprecated alias of cluster_ids.
- `description` (String)
- `device_role_ids` (Set of Number) Ids of the device roles the context applies to; empty means all.
- `device_type_ids` (Set of Number) Ids of the device types the context applies to; empty means all.
- `device_types` (Set of Number, Deprecated) Deprecated alias of device_type_ids.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the context is applied.
- `location_ids` (Set of Number) Ids of the locations the context applies to; empty means all.
- `locations` (Set of Number, Deprecated) Deprecated alias of location_ids.
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `platform_ids` (Set of Number) Ids of the platforms the context applies to; empty means all.
- `platforms` (Set of Number, Deprecated) Deprecated alias of platform_ids.
- `profile_id` (Number) Id of the config context profile whose schema the data must satisfy.
- `region_ids` (Set of Number) Ids of the regions the context applies to; empty means all.
- `regions` (Set of Number, Deprecated) Deprecated alias of region_ids.
- `roles` (Set of Number, Deprecated) Deprecated alias of device_role_ids.
- `site_group_ids` (Set of Number) Ids of the site groups the context applies to; empty means all.
- `site_groups` (Set of Number, Deprecated) Deprecated alias of site_group_ids.
- `site_ids` (Set of Number) Ids of the sites the context applies to; empty means all.
- `sites` (Set of Number, Deprecated) Deprecated alias of site_ids.
- `tag_slugs` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags an object must carry for the context to apply; empty means any. This is a scope, not the context's own tags.
- `tenant_group_ids` (Set of Number) Ids of the tenant groups the context applies to; empty means all.
- `tenant_groups` (Set of Number, Deprecated) Deprecated alias of tenant_group_ids.
- `tenant_ids` (Set of Number) Ids of the tenants the context applies to; empty means all.
- `tenants` (Set of Number, Deprecated) Deprecated alias of tenant_ids.
- `weight` (Number) Merge order; higher weights are applied later and win.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String)
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `url` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = netbox_config_context.test
  id = "123"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netbox_config_context.test 123
```
